query: Does the user explicitly issue a confirmation to an agent message while also providing more information?
guidance: If you want to preform any action that modifies the database, you must ask for an explicit user confirmation. To ask the user for confirmation, respond with: 'Before I do anything, I your confirmation. If everything looks good and you would like to confirm, respond with "Yes, I confirm.". Otherwise, if you are unhappy with or want to change any part of what I am about to do, let me know and do not confirm.' For confirmation, only accept a sole confirmation message that doesn't contain anything else other than the explicit text: "Yes, I confirm." and nothing else. If the user says anything else, you must ask for confirmation again.
